messages:
anna-product: Dropping a quick thread for the compact retention + KMS flow. Updated mock in Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Main open questions: compact KMS pill text/icons, retention preset wording, timezone display on audit rows, and how region fallback is announced to SR users. Would love quick takes.

sam-design: Nice work. Quick visual nit: compact pill looks cramped in the header. Can we shorten label to 'Key ownership' and use very short tokens 'Hosted / Customer / Pending'? Also thinking an outlined shield+key icon instead of full lock — less 'encrypted only' and more 'ownership'.

marta-ux: Accessibility points: use aria-describedby linking the pill to the explanatory text, and add role=status + aria-live=polite for transitions from Pending->Customer so screen readers hear the update. For keyboard order, prefer: region dropdown -> retention preset -> key pill -> Save. That keeps flow linear.

leo-frontend: Implementation flags: the outlined shield+key icon has to exist in our icon set; I'll add it. The pill in compact header needs smaller padding; CSS token --pill-gap can go from 8px to 6px. Also watch truncation on very small screens, we should show tooltip with full phrase.

tim-eng: Contrast/UX. Current green (#2ec27a) fails AA for 14px body copy. Recommend #178a56 for >=4.5:1. Also for the 'Pending' state use an orange that meets contrast, not pale yellow. I'll prepare updated color tokens and small PR to components. On region fallback: instead of 'Auto (EU)' present 'EU — fallback' visually and programmatically expose a helper text node with aria-describedby to explain the policy.

grace-qa: QA perspective: audit rows need two changes: show actor for key events (e.g., 'KMS: customer key rotation — initiated by @name') and display both local time + offset tooltip (ex: 'Mar 18, 2026 09:12 CET (UTC+1)'). Automated tests rely on stable string fragments, so please keep prefix 'KMS:' consistent.

sam-design: For retention presets i propose friendly names: 'Strict (30d)', 'Balanced (90d)', 'Keep indefinitely'. Avoid 'Infinite' or 'Forever'. Also add a short explainer under each preset: what gets deleted (messages, logs, blobs) — one line.

marta-ux: For screen readers, ensure the retention preset selection announces the chosen preset name and a short summary. Use aria-live polite for the summary region but debounce 300ms to avoid noisy announcements when quickly tabbing through.

leo-frontend: Small note: the compact header has a hover tooltip for the key pill already; let's ensure tooltip content equals visible brief label + 'More info' link that opens the side panel rather than duplicating long copy.

tim-eng: Also add a data-attribute for telemetry: data-retention-preset and data-kms-state so we can instrument changes without leaking sensitive info.

deploybot: deploybot: staging preview is live: https://staging.redwood.example/design-previews/2032109876 — includes icon, color token updates, and tooltip tweaks. :rocket:

grace-qa: I'll run an a11y scan once staging is up. Quick checklist I'm using: keyboard-only flow, screen reader announcements for pill state, focus visible on Save, contrast ratios, and truncated labels still accessible via tooltips/aria-labels.

anna-product: Great. Can we aim for a dev PR by Thursday so QA has time to test? Also I'll standardize audit copy: 'KMS: Customer key rotated by <user>' as the canonical string we use in logs, and we'll include user handle and timestamp. I'll add that to the docs. Thanks folks! :pray:
